about:
Orion Manufacturing LLC was founded in 2009 by Byron N. Foote and Geoffrey Foote in Groton, Connecticut, with Byron C. Foote joining the firm later. The company began as a modern architectural woodworking facility focused on the production of custom millwork and furnishings for interior spaces.

The shop specializes in fabricating and installing architectural millwork and custom furnishings, serving projects throughout New England. Its craftsmen are tasked with meeting demanding specifications and quality standards, though the company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual output figures.

Orion works primarily with architects, interior designers, and general contractors on commercial and residential projects across the Northeast; the company does not list specific industry sectors or named clients in its public materials.

According to the founders, the business was built to blend innovation, high-quality materials, and ingenuity to create stunning finished interiors, with the capacity to meet exacting specifications presented as its defining advantage.
